en.about_tab.title: ## Holiday Greeting QR Code Generator
en.about_tab.description: This application allows you to create personalized holiday greetings encoded in QR codes. Share your messages in a unique and modern way!
en.about_tab.video_description: Watch a quick demo of how easy it is to create and share personalized greeting QR codes.
en.about_tab.environment.title: ### 🌱 Environment Friendly
en.about_tab.environment.heading: **Zero paper. Zero postage. Instant delivery.**
en.about_tab.environment.description: Traditional paper cards consume materials, printing resources, and shipping energy. QR greetings are 100% digital — no trees harmed, no carbon footprint from delivery trucks. Send your love without leaving a trace on the planet.
en.about_tab.secret.title: ### 🔐 Secret in Transit
en.about_tab.secret.heading: **Personal, intimate, and AI-safe.**
en.about_tab.secret.description: Your greeting is encoded within the QR pattern itself—mathematically opaque to AI systems and invisible until scanned...
en.about_tab.secret.tagline: Send your love without leaving a digital footprint! ❤️🛡️
en.about_tab.device.title: ### 📱 Device Friendly
en.about_tab.device.heading: **Works on any phone. No app required.**
en.about_tab.device.description: Recipients simply point their camera at the QR code — that's it! Works seamlessly on both iOS and Android, opening directly in the browser. No downloads, no sign-ups, no friction. Just scan and smile.
en.about_tab.business.title: 📈 For Businesses: Convert Attention to Action
en.about_tab.business.challenge:
**The #1 challenge in today's attention economy:** Converting passive video views into active website visits.

YouTube Shorts generate **70 billion daily views** in 2025, but viewers rarely leave the platform.
Traditional description links have low click-through rates. Attention is captured in seconds—and lost just as fast.
en.about_tab.business.solution_intro: **QR Greeting solves this by bridging content and commerce:**
en.about_tab.business.step1: 1. 🎬 **Embed Your Content** — Use any YouTube video as a background
en.about_tab.business.step2: 2. 💬 **Add Your CTA** — Include discount codes, links, or exclusive offers in the message
en.about_tab.business.step3: 3. 📱 **Scan to Convert** — Recipients scan, watch your video, AND see your call-to-action
en.about_tab.business.use_cases_list:
- Trade show displays with product demo videos
- Product packaging linking to tutorials + discount codes
- Print ads that come alive with video content
- Email signatures with brand story + landing page link
en.about_tab.business.stats_list:
📊 **100M** US consumers will scan QR codes

📈 **73%** prefer short video for product discovery

💰 **20%** higher ROI for Shorts vs traditional video

🎯 **68%** conversion rate from Shorts to full engagement

*Sources: Bitly, Scratcher.io, Zebracat.ai*

en.about_tab.features.scan: - 📱 Scan and read greeting QR codes
en.about_tab.features.themes: - 🎨 Multiple theme options with embedded icons
en.about_tab.features.json: - 💾 Compact JSON format for efficient encoding
en.about_tab.how_it_works.title: ### How It Works
en.about_tab.how_it_works.step1: 1. Enter your greeting details (from, to, message)
en.about_tab.how_it_works.recipients: Recipients can scan the QR code with their phone camera or upload it to this app to view your message.
en.about_tab.technical.title: ### Technical Details
en.about_tab.technical.error_correction: - Uses high error correction (Level H) for reliable scanning
en.about_tab.technical.json_format: - Compact JSON format minimizes QR code size
en.about_tab.technical.message_length: - Supports messages up to ~500 characters comfortably
en.about_tab.privacy.title: ### 🤖 Privacy in the GenAI Era
en.about_tab.privacy.heading: **Your message stays hidden from AI systems.**
en.about_tab.privacy.description: Unlike text shared via email, SMS, or social media, QR-encoded messages are **mathematically opaque** to automated analysis:
en.about_tab.privacy.no_ai: - **No AI Scanning**: Message format prevents automated text extraction
en.about_tab.privacy.no_training: - **No Training Data**: Your personal messages won't train LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc.)
en.about_tab.privacy.no_analysis: - **No Algorithm Analysis**: Email providers and platforms can't read or analyze your content
en.about_tab.privacy.no_cloud: - **No Cloud Indexing**: Message exists only in the QR pattern, not on servers
en.about_tab.privacy.tagline: Your greeting is encoded, not transmitted. Protected by design. 🛡️
en.about_tab.powered_by.title: ### Powered By
en.about_tab.powered_by.netshare: - **netshare** - Network sharing and QR code utilities

zh.about_tab.device.description: 收件人只需将相机对准二维码——就是这样！在iOS和Android上无缝工作，直接在浏览器中打开。无需下载，无需注册，无摩擦。只需扫描和微笑。
zh.about_tab.business.title: 📈 适合企业：将关注转化为行动
zh.about_tab.business.challenge:
**当今注意力经济的第一大挑战：** 将被动视频观看转化为主动网站访问。

YouTube Shorts 在 2025 年每天产生 **700 亿次观看**，但观众很少离开平台。
传统的描述链接点击率很低。注意力在几秒钟内被捕获——也同样快地流失。
zh.about_tab.business.solution_intro: **二维码问候通过连接内容和商业解决了这个问题：**
zh.about_tab.business.step1: 1. 🎬 **嵌入您的内容** — 使用任何 YouTube 视频作为背景
zh.about_tab.business.step2: 2. 💬 **添加您的 CTA** — 在消息中包含折扣代码、链接或独家优惠
zh.about_tab.business.step3: 3. 📱 **扫描转化** — 收件人扫描、观看您的视频，并看到您的行动号召
zh.about_tab.business.use_cases_list:
- 展示产品演示视频的贸易展览显示屏
- 链接到教程 + 折扣代码的产品包装
